newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell unit SNEPCO develops Nigerian oil well.
newsitem.headline: Shell unit SNEPCO develops Nigerian oil well.

text.p: Shell Nigeria Exploration Production Company (SNEPCO), a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell Group's Nigerian unit, has completed drilling an oil well in Ngolo in oil-rich Niger Delta, a senior company official said on Wednesday.
"Further tests are still being carried out on the developed well -- SETCO-FOREX 709," he told Reuters, adding that it was a deep-water well with a depth of about 12,000 feet.
SNEPCO, which is wholly-owned by Shell, was launched in 1993 to operate three oil licences under production sharing contracts (PSC) awarded by the government.
Under PSCs operators shoulder the cost of exploration and production and recoup this if oil is struck.
Shell is one of six multinationals operating in Nigeria and pumps about half the country's two million barrels per day of crude oil.
